playersCeremony.policyUse: scores 95,90,80,65,50,35 for hand sizes 0-5; score 0 if own deck <=2; subtract 15 when opponent handCount <=2 and 20 when own deckCount <=4

playersCeremony.confidence: synthetic actor-view heuristic only; native card-effect hook separately verified; no complete rank-3 game
playersCeremony.terminalSequencing: The policy defers positively scored non-terminal actions before choosing attack/pass or supported draw-and-end-turn Stadium uses; synthetic competing-action tests cover Player's Ceremony and Tropical Beach versus beneficial retreat.
playersCeremony.openQuestion: Opponent low-deck incentives and paper partial-draw interpretation remain unmodeled/unverified; the effect is optional.
